apps.localizedDescription:
TwitchPlusK is a tweak for the official Twitch iOS app. It keeps the native app and adds a fully customizable chat, 7TV/BTTV/FFZ emotes, adblock, Channel Points Auto Claim, OLED mode and more.

Available in ENGLISH and FRENCH from the Settings menu.

Chat and emotes:

• Reply to messages, view threads, and customize deleted-message display.
• Use 7TV, BTTV, and FFZ emotes, including animated and Zero-Width emotes.
• Search emotes, manage favorites, and import favorites from PC.
• Choose picker providers, animations, and the opening tab.

Ad blocking:

• Proxy — block stream ads through a default or custom proxy.
• Local (VAFT) — block stream ads without a video proxy.
• Proxy + Local (VAFT) — combine a stream relay with local ad blocking.

TwitchPlusK release info:

• Twitch app version: 31.9.
• Full changelog: CHANGELOG.md.

Fixes:

• Fixed the emote picker button missing when Twitch’s Bits button is unavailable: it now appears directly to the left of the native emote button.
